subject: DI05005051

body.en:
Definition

A complex/compound fertilizer contains two or more primary nutrients through its manufacturing process, usually with the nutrient components associated within product granules. A mixed/bulk-blended fertilizer is produced by physical blending of compatible component fertilizers;its separate particles may have different compositions.

Examples and distinctions

NP:DAP, MAP and specified nitrophosphate grades. NPK:compound grades with all three label nutrients. ASP supplies N, P and S.CAN is retained here because the syllabus lists it here, butit is an AN/mineral formulation rather than a unique multi-primary-nutrient molecule. Numbers on a grade label are%N–%P2O5 equivalent–%K2O equivalent;S/Mg/Ca may be declared additionally.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Manufacturing process થી બે કે વધુ primary nutrients આપતું અને સામાન્ય રીતે granules માં components સાથે ધરાવતું fertilizer complex/compound છે. Mixed/bulk-blended fertilizer compatible components નું physical mixture છે;અલગ particles ની composition જુદી હોઈ શકે.

Examples તથા Distinctions

NP માં DAP, MAP/selectednitrophosphates;NPK માંત્રણેય label nutrients વાળા compound grades;ASP માં N/P/S. CAN syllabus મુજબઅહીંછે, પણ unique multi-primary molecule નહીં—AN/mineral formulation છે. Label numbers%N–%P2O5 equivalent–%K2O equivalent છે;S/Mg/Ca અલગ de cl are થઈ શકે.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

The selected compound-NPK route incorporates nitrogen, phosphate and potassium sources through slurry reaction/granulation to a specified nutrient grade.

Raw materials and principle

Authorised N/P/K sources, ammonia/acids where selected, and approved conditioning materials.

Neutralisation depends on selected feed;there is no single universal NPK molecular formula.

Source identification

Selected chemical-slurry/granulation route, not mere bulk blending. N–P–K numbers mean%N–%P2O5 equivalent–%K2O equivalent, not elemental N–P–K mass percentages.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

The study links grade/material-balance specification, feed preparation, neutralisation/slurry formation, granulator, dryer/cooler, screen/coating and packing. Scrubbing connects to emission-generating stages;it is not an operation after finished-product packing.

1.Grade design and slurry formation

The nutrient balance chooses compatible sources and accounts for moisture, impurities and any retained carrier. Neutralisation chemistry develops an appropriate slurry for the chosen grade. There is no single universal NPK molecular formula, and a blend calculation alone does not describe chemical-granulation equipment.

2.Granulation, size recycle and release

Slurry/feed deposition and controlled agglomeration build granules. Drying removes moisture and cooling improves handling;screening separates qualified product from fines/oversize. Qualified size recycle returns to granulation while scrubbing recovers/captures compatible gas-borne nutrients. Grade, uniformity, moisture and mechanical quality are tested.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control nutrient ratio, slurry behaviour, granule size, strength, compatible recycle, corrosion and emission/effluent loads.

Applications / product boundary

Compound multi-nutrient fertilizer with a verified declared grade;not an agronomic dosing recommendation.

વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

Selected compound-NPK route માં N/P/K sources slurry reaction/granulation થી specified grade માંજોડાય છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

AuthorisedN/P/K sources, selected NH3/acids તથા approved conditioning materials.

Neutralisation depends on selected feed;there is no single universal NPK molecular formula.

Source ની ઓળખ

Selected chemical-slurry/granulation route છે, ફક્ત bulk blending નહીં. N–P–Kgrade=%N–%P2O5 equivalent–%K2O equivalent છે, elementalN–P–K નહીં.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Study માં grade balance, feeds, neutralisation/slurry, granulator, dryer/cooler, screen/coating/packing છે. Scrubbing gas-generating stages સાથે connected છે, packing પછીનથી.

1.Grade Design તથા Slurry Formation

Nutrient balance માં compatible feeds, moisture, impurities/carrier ગણાય છે. Neutralisation થી chosen grade માટે slurry બને છે. Universal NPK molecular formula નથી;blend calculation માત્ર chemical granulation equipment સમજાવતુંનથી.

2.Granulation, Size Recycle તથા Release

Slurry deposition/agglomeration થી granules બને છે. Drying moisture કાઢે છે, cooling handling સુધારે છે;screening product/fines/oversize જુદાં કરે છે. Qualified recycle granulator માંઅને gasescrubbing માં જાય છે. Grade, uniformity, moisture/strength તપાસાય છે.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Nutrient ratio, slurry, size, strength, recycle compatibility, corrosion/emissions નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Verified declared grade વાળું compound fertilizer;agronomic dose advice નહીં.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

Ammonium sulphate phosphate is a specified NP/Scompound fertilizer grade formed by mixed-acid ammoniation and product finishing.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified phosphoric/sulphuric acid, ammonia and approved recycle.

2NH3+H2SO4→(NH4)2SO4;NH3/H3PO4 forms selected ammonium-phosphate species.

Source identification

NP+Scompound grade obtained through selected mixed-acid ammoniation/granulation;not a fixed universal pure molecular salt.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

Mixed-acid preparation and ammoniation feed a slurry/granulation train with dryer/cooler, screen, recycle and packing;off-gas goes to compatible scrubbing.

1.Mixed-acid neutralisation

Ammonia neutralises sulphuric acid to ammonium sulphate and phosphoric acid to the selected ammonium-phosphate species. Proportions/speciation determine the grade rather than a single universal ASP formula. Heat and ammonia losses are managed in the designed contact system.

2.Granulation and quality

The nutrient-bearing mass is granulated, dried/cooled and screened. Qualified fines return as seed/material while gas scrubbing limits nutrient emissions. Release testing checks N, P2O5 equivalent, S, moisture and particle quality;visual uniformity alone cannot establish nutrient grade.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Acid impurity balance, neutralisation heat, free acidity/ammonia, caking and recycle composition are key issues.

Applications / product boundary

Qualified NP plus sulfur fertilizer.

વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

ASP mixed-acid ammoniation/finishing થીબનતો specified NP/Scompound grade છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

QualifiedH3PO4/H2SO4,NH3 તથા approved recycle.

2NH3+H2SO4→(NH4)2SO4;NH3/H3PO4 forms selected ammonium-phosphate species.

Source ની ઓળખ

Selected mixed-acid ammoniation/granulation થી NP+Scompound grade મળે છે;fixed pure molecular salt નહીં.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Mixed-acid preparation/ammoniation પછી slurry/granulation, dryer/cooler, screen, recycle/packing છે;off-gas compatible scrubber માં જાય છે.

1.Mixed-acid Neutralisation

NH3 થી H2SO4 નું AS તથા H3PO4 નું selected ammonium phosphate બને છે. Proportions/speciation થી grade નક્કી થાય છે, universal ASP formula થીનહીં. Designed system heat/NH3 lossmanage કરે છે.

2.Granulation તથા Quality

Massgranulate, dry/cool/screen થાય છે. Qualified fines પાછાંજાયછે;scrubbing emissions ઘટાડે છે. N, P2O5 equivalent, S, moisture/particles તપાસાય છે;appearance માત્રથી grade સાબિતનથી.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Acid impurities, neutralisation heat, free acidity/NH3,caking/recycle composition મુખ્યમુદ્દા છે.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Qualified NP તથા S fertilizer.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

CAN is a specified ammonium-nitrate/mineral-carbonate fertilizer formulation, not pure calcium nitrate or one fixed molecular compound.

Raw materials and principle

Authorised AN stream and qualified limestone/dolomite under an approved product specification.

Physical incorporation into a specified product;not simply Ca(NO3)2 synthesis.

Source identification

CAN is a specified ammonium-nitrate/mineral-carbonate formulation, not calcium nitrate or a unique pure compound. High-level licensed-manufacturing overview only;no ratios or operating setpoints.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

The conceptual train contains material qualification, controlled mineral incorporation, approved granulation/solidification, cooling/screening, quality release and authorised storage. Emission capture is a separate controlled branch.

1.Qualified incorporation

The mineral component is incorporated within the licensed process to achieve the declared fertilizer grade and physical form. Compatibility and impurity specifications matter;adding arbitrary material does not create a safe product. This overview omits component ratios, concentration targets and operating settings.

2.Finishing and authorised release

The approved finishing system develops and cools product particles. Screening, dust control and release tests verify physical/nutrient specifications. Storage follows product-specific compatibility and regulatory requirements;mineral incorporation does not remove all AN-related hazards.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Contamination, thermal decomposition, confinement, product variability and incompatible storage remain specialist safety concerns.

Applications / product boundary

Authorised nitrogen-fertilizer grade;no explosive-use or home-manufacture guidance.

CAN specified AN/mineral-carbonate formulation છે, pure calcium nitrate/એક fixed compound નહીં.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Authorised AN stream તથા approved specification નું limestone/dolomite.

Physical incorporation into a specified product;not simply Ca(NO3)2 synthesis.

Source ની ઓળખ

CAN specified ammonium-nitrate/mineral-carbonate formulation છે, calcium nitrate/unique pure compound નહીં. ફક્ત licensed industrial overview;ratios/setpoints નહીં.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Conceptual train માં qualification, mineral incorporation, approved granulation/solidification, cooling/screening, release/storage છે. Emission capture અલગ branch છે.

1.Qualified Incorporation

Mineral component licensed process માં declared grade/form માટે incorporate થાય છે. Compatibility/impurities મહત્વનાંછે;arbitrary material ઉમેરવાથી safe product નથીબનતો. Ratios, concentration targets/settings આપેલનથી.

2.Finishing તથા Authorised Release

Approved finishing particles બનાવી cool કરે છે. Screening, dust/release tests થી specifications verify થાય છે. Storage product-specific rules મુજબછે;mineral incorporation થીબધા AN hazards દૂરનથીથતાં.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Contamination, thermal decomposition, confinement, variability/incompatible storage specialist concerns છે.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

AuthorisedNfertilizergrade;explosive-use/home manufacture guidance નથી.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

DAP, diammonium hydrogen phosphate,(NH4)2HPO4,is an NP fertilizer produced through controlled phosphoric-acid ammoniation.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified phosphoric acid, ammonia and compatible recycle/conditioning materials.

H3PO4+NH3→NH4H2PO4;NH4H2PO4+NH3→(NH4)2HPO4.

Source identification

Staged ammoniation controls MAP/DAP speciation;grade, free ammonia and moisture require analysis. No agricultural application doses are prescribed.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

The flow has acid conditioning, ammoniation/slurry preparation, granulator/ammoniation finishing, dryer/cooler, screen/coating, packing and ammonia-bearing gas scrubbing. Recycle liquor and size recycle have separate functions.

1.Ammoniation and phosphate species

Initial ammonia addition forms monoammonium phosphate;further selected ammoniation develops the intended DAP-rich product. Phosphoric-acid impurities and ammonia losses influence the required balance. The ideal2:1NH3:H3PO4 molar relation is a chemical reference, not an unvalidated operating feed-setting instruction.

2.Granulation, scrubbing and grade

Granulation develops particles while drying/cooling and screening establish the physical product. Compatible scrub liquor returns recovered nutrients and qualified size recycle aids granulation. Product testing distinguishes the commercial grade from the theoretical composition of pure DAP;free ammonia, moisture and available phosphate also matter.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control ammoniation/speciation, acid impurities, ammonia escape, corrosion, moisture, caking and granule strength.

Applications / product boundary

NP fertilizer with a verified label;pure-compound calculations do not replace certified analysis.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

DAP,(NH4)2HPO4,controlledH3PO4 ammoniation થીબનતું NP fertilizer છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

QualifiedH3PO4,NH3 તથા compatible recycle/conditioning materials.

H3PO4+NH3→NH4H2PO4;NH4H2PO4+NH3→(NH4)2HPO4.

Source ની ઓળખ

Staged ammoniation થી MAP/DAP speciation નિયંત્રિત થાય છે;grade, free ammonia/moisture analysis જોઈએ. Agricultural doses નથી.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Flow માં acid conditioning, ammoniation/slurry, granulator, dryer/cooler, screen/coating/packing તથા NH3 scrubbing છે. Liquor તથા size recycles ના functions જુદા છે.

1.Ammoniation તથા Phosphate Species

Initial NH3 થી MAP અને further ammoniation થી DAP-rich product બને છે. Acid impurities/NH3 loss balance નેઅસરકરે છે. Ideal2:1 molar relation chemical reference છે, unvalidated operating feed setting નહીં.

2.Granulation, Scrubbing તથા Grade

Granulation particles બનાવે છે;dry/cool/screen physical product આપે છે. Compatible scrub liquor nutrients તથા qualified size recycle granulation માંપાછાંઆવે છે. CommercialgradepureDAPtheory થીઅલગતપાસાય છે;freeNH3,moisture/availableP પણમહત્વનાંછે.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Ammoniation/speciation, impurities, NH3 escape, corrosion, moisture/caking/strength નિયંત્રિતકરવા.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Verified label વાળું NP fertilizer;theoretical calculations certified analysis નોબદલોનથી.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

The selected Odda-type nitrophosphate route digests phosphate rock with nitric acid and manages calcium before NP/NPK finishing.

Raw materials and principle

Phosphate rock, nitric acid, ammonia and an optional qualified potassium source.

Ca3(PO4)2+6HNO3→2H3PO4+3Ca(NO3)2(ideal rock model).

Source identification

Representative nitric-acid rock digestion with calcium-nitrate separation followed by neutralisation/granulation. Other nitrophosphate variants have different calcium management;do not call all of them the same flowsheet.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

The study links rock preparation, digestion, insoluble removal, calcium-nitrate crystallisation/separation, ammoniation and granulation/finishing. Scrubbing treats digestion gas;other nitrophosphate technologies use different calcium-conversion arrangements.

1.Digestion and calcium separation

Nitric-acid attack forms phosphoric-acid/calcium-nitrate-bearing liquor. Insolubles are removed and controlled industrial crystallisation separates a calcium-nitrate-rich phase in the selected route. This calcium removal is not gypsum filtration from sulphuric-acid wet processing.

2.Nutrient adjustment and finishing

The remaining liquor is ammoniated and conditioned for an NP grade or combined with a compatible K source for NPK.Granulation, drying/cooling and screening establish product form while size recycle and gas recovery follow qualified loops. Nitrate and ammonium species depend on the actual process balance.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Rock impurities, acid corrosion, calcium-nitrate separation, heat balance, emissions and mother-liquor management require control.

Applications / product boundary

Specified nitrophosphate NP/NPK fertilizer;not one universal formulation for every plant.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

Selected Odda-type route માં rock ને HNO3 થી digest કરી calcium management પછી NP/NPK finishing થાય છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Rock, HNO3,NH3 તથા optionalqualifiedKsource.

Ca3(PO4)2+6HNO3→2H3PO4+3Ca(NO3)2(ideal rock model).

Source ની ઓળખ

Representative Odda-type માં nitric-acid rock digestion પછી calcium-nitrate separation તથા neutralisation/granulation છે. Other nitrophosphate variants માં calcium management જુદુંછે.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Study માં rock preparation, digestion, insolubles, Ca(NO3)2 crystallisation/separation, ammoniation/granulation છે. Digestion gas scrub થાય છે;other technologies નું calcium arrangement જુદુંહોયછે.

1.Digestion તથા Calcium Separation

HNO3 attack થી H3PO4/Ca(NO3)2 liquor બને છે. Insolubles પછી selected crystallisation Ca-nitrate-rich phase કાઢે છે. આ H2SO4 wet process નું gypsum filtration નથી.

2.Nutrient Adjustment તથા Finishing

Remainingliquorammoniate/condition થઈ NP અથવા K source સાથે NPK આપે છે. Granulate, dry/cool/screen થી form મળે છે;recycle/gas recovery qualified loops માંછે. Nitrate/ammonium species actual balance મુજબછે.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Rock impurities, acid corrosion, Ca-nitrate separation, heat/emissions તથા motherliquor નિયંત્રિતકરવા.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Specified nitrophosphate NP/NPK;દરેક plant માટેએક universal formulation નથી.

1.Given:2NH3+H3PO4→(NH4)2HPO4;M(NH3)=17.03,M(H3PO4)=98.00g/mol.

2.Find:ideal molar and pure-material mass ratio.

3.Molar NH3:H3PO4=2:1.

4.Mass ratio=2×17.03/98.00=0.3476 kgNH3/kgpureH3PO4.

5.For100 kgpureH3PO4,idealNH3=34.76 kg. This is stoichiometry, not a plant feed recipe;real feeds, impurities and losses require the actual authorised balance.

Apparatus / approved materials

Teacher-validated DAP formol SOP, standard alkali, neutralised formaldehyde, blank/reference and volumetric apparatus.

Supervised procedure / process record

Prepare the assigned DAP solution, record initial conditioning and phosphate/matrix correction, then perform supervised formol treatment/titration. Run blank/reference checks. Report the exact endpoint and factor;do not transplant the NH4Cl method uncorrected to DAP.

Blank observations—actual work required

m:____;stock/aliquot:____;N:____;titres/blank:____;phosphatecorrection:____;endpoint:____

Calculation / result

%N=1.4007N×corrected ammonium-equivalent titre×F/m only where the validated DAPSOPsupports1 eq/N.

Actual result:____;units/basis:____;SOP:____.No experimental result is supplied.

Precautions / waste

Formaldehyde/alkali hood, PPE, waste controls;phosphate correction and reference recovery are mandatory analytical checks.

Aim

Nitrogen in DAP—Kjeldahl method

Principle

Ammonium nitrogen is liberated/captured and measured by the assigned Kjeldahl-type method;sample pretreatment depends on actual nitrogen species.

Apparatus / approved materials

Approved distillation/capture/titration assembly, blank, reference material and standard reagents.

Supervised procedure / process record

Weigh/prepare DAP by the assigned method. Record pretreatment and quantitative ammonia transfer into the specified receiver. Run blank/reference and determine corrected titration. Report the nitrogen basis and compare only with a declared analysis, not an assumed pure-DAP value.

Blank observations—actual work required

m:____;pretreatment:____;N:____;blank/sampletitres:____;F:____;recovery:____

Calculation / result

%N=1.4007N×receiver-specific corrected titre×F/m.

Actual result:____;units/basis:____;SOP:____.No experimental result is supplied.

Precautions / waste

Hot alkali, ammonia and glassware pressure risks require trained supervision and prescribed ventilation.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Complex fertilizers—definition and classification.
q.gu: Complex Fertilizers—વ્યાખ્યા તથા વર્ગીકરણનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: A complex/compound fertilizer contains two or more primary nutrients through its manufacturing process, usually with the nutrient components associated within product granules. A mixed/bulk-blended fertilizer is produced by physical blending of compatible component fertilizers;its separate particles may have different compositions. NP:DAP, MAP and specified nitrophosphate grades. NPK:compound grades with all three label nutrients. ASP supplies N, P and S.CAN is retained here because the syllabus lists it here, butit is an AN/mineral formulation rather than a unique multi-primary-nutrient molecule. Numbers on a grade label are%N–%P2O5 equivalent–%K2O equivalent;S/Mg/Ca may be declared additionally.
a.gu: Manufacturing process થી બે કે વધુ primary nutrients આપતું અને સામાન્ય રીતે granules માં components સાથે ધરાવતું fertilizer complex/compound છે. Mixed/bulk-blended fertilizer compatible components નું physical mixture છે;અલગ particles ની composition જુદી હોઈ શકે. NP માં DAP, MAP/selectednitrophosphates;NPK માંત્રણેય label nutrients વાળા compound grades;ASP માં N/P/S. CAN syllabus મુજબઅહીંછે, પણ unique multi-primary molecule નહીં—AN/mineral formulation છે. Label numbers%N–%P2O5 equivalent–%K2O equivalent છે;S/Mg/Ca અલગ de cl are થઈ શકે.

q.en: State the principle/definition of NPK—compound granulation route.

a.en: The selected compound-NPK route incorporates nitrogen, phosphate and potassium sources through slurry reaction/granulation to a specified nutrient grade. Authorised N/P/K sources, ammonia/acids where selected, and approved conditioning materials.
a.gu: Selected compound-NPK route માં N/P/K sources slurry reaction/granulation થી specified grade માંજોડાય છે. AuthorisedN/P/K sources, selected NH3/acids તથા approved conditioning materials.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Ammonium sulphate phosphate.

a.en: Ammonium sulphate phosphate is a specified NP/Scompound fertilizer grade formed by mixed-acid ammoniation and product finishing. Qualified phosphoric/sulphuric acid, ammonia and approved recycle.
a.gu: ASP mixed-acid ammoniation/finishing થીબનતો specified NP/Scompound grade છે. QualifiedH3PO4/H2SO4,NH3 તથા approved recycle.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Calcium ammonium nitrate—industrial overview.
q.gu: Calcium Ammonium Nitrate—Industrial Overviewનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: CAN is a specified ammonium-nitrate/mineral-carbonate fertilizer formulation, not pure calcium nitrate or one fixed molecular compound. Authorised AN stream and qualified limestone/dolomite under an approved product specification.
a.gu: CAN specified AN/mineral-carbonate formulation છે, pure calcium nitrate/એક fixed compound નહીં. Authorised AN stream તથા approved specification નું limestone/dolomite.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Diammonium phosphate.

a.en: DAP, diammonium hydrogen phosphate,(NH4)2HPO4,is an NP fertilizer produced through controlled phosphoric-acid ammoniation. Qualified phosphoric acid, ammonia and compatible recycle/conditioning materials.
a.gu: DAP,(NH4)2HPO4,controlledH3PO4 ammoniation થીબનતું NP fertilizer છે. QualifiedH3PO4,NH3 તથા compatible recycle/conditioning materials.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Nitrophosphate—Odda-type route.

a.en: The selected Odda-type nitrophosphate route digests phosphate rock with nitric acid and manages calcium before NP/NPK finishing. Phosphate rock, nitric acid, ammonia and an optional qualified potassium source.
a.gu: Selected Odda-type route માં rock ને HNO3 થી digest કરી calcium management પછી NP/NPK finishing થાય છે. Rock, HNO3,NH3 તથા optionalqualifiedKsource.
